method: Direct visual inspection of all 16 actual Poppler-rendered full-page PNG files with view_image, in four batches of four. Individual pages inspected at supplied full-page resolution, not contact-sheet or extraction-only approval.
sample_scope: 12 full-book leaves 7,19,23,41,49,65,77,83,95,109,121,137 and 4 standalone pages for CASE02/16/21/30, indexed 4/19/24/34.
observations: Bold book speaker labels and individually separated standalone cards keep turn-taking legible. No clipped dialogue, overlap, missing glyphs, or misplaced speaker labels observed in this sample. Dialogue remains easy to read against case prose. The full-book running header visibly retains ENGLISH READING EDITION V8 from the source reading edition; this sample pass concerns dialogue readability, not a changed production edition label.
limits: Sampled screen reading proof only; no claim of checking all 225 book pages visually, testing with children, professional psychological evaluation, or a physical printed proof. This is not a production print-ready certification.
